places.name: The Farwatch
places.epithet: The westernmost manned post in the Union
places.text: The citadel's watch-tower. On clear days its keepers claim to see the green line of Thal'vireth. Few believe them.

places.name: The Ground-Field
places.epithet: For skycraft too heavy to reach the Loom
places.text: A broad, level field on the coastal highland, cleared and rolled, where skycraft too heavy to reach the Loom come down.

places.name: The Field Sheds
places.text: Long sheds at the field's edge where skycraft are moored, mended and unloaded.

places.name: The Keep
places.text: The citadel's commander's hall and armoury.

places.name: The Citadel Walls
places.text: A citadel on the coastal highlands.

places.name: The Parade
places.text: The citadel's yard, where the garrison musters.

places.name: The Sapphire Road
places.text: The road along which most of Skyloom's instruments, glass and flight-gear travel.
